mapper.select: SELECT IDEA_ID FROM TB_IDEA WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' FOR UPDATE

SELECT C.ANSR_ID AS COMMENT_ID, C.IDEA_ID, NULLIF(C.UP_ANSR_ID, '') AS PARENT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.ANSR_USER_ID AS CREATE_ID, C.DEPTH, C.SORT_ORD, U.USER_NM AS CREATE_NM, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATE_DT FROM tb_idea_ansr C JOIN TB_IDEA I ON I.IDEA_ID = C.IDEA_ID AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = C.ANSR_USER_ID WHERE C.IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_ORD, C.CREATE_DT, C.ANSR_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_idea_ansr (ANSR_ID, IDEA_ID, UP_ANSR_ID, CONTENT, ANSR_USER_ID, DEPTH, SORT_ORD, CREATE_ID) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{ideaId}, #{parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content}, #{createId}, #{depth}, #{sortOrd}, #{createId})
mapper.sql: FROM TB_IDEA I LEFT JOIN TB_AGT A ON A.AGENT_ID = I.AGENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = I.CREATE_ID

ORDER BY I.CREATE_DT DESC, I.IDEA_ID DESC LIMIT #{firstIndex}, #{recordCountPerPage}
/* 아이디어 목록 건수 idea.selectIdeaListCnt */ SELECT COUNT(1)

/* 아이디어 상세 조회 idea.selectIdeaDetail */ SELECT I.IDEA_ID , I.IDEA_TYPE_CD , I.AGENT_ID , A.AGENT_NM , I.TITLE , I.CONTENT , AS COMMENT_CNT , I.LIKE_CNT , CASE WHEN L.USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS LIKED_YN , I.CREATE_ID , U.USER_NM AS CREATE_NM , DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT
LEFT JOIN tb_idea_like L ON L.IDEA_ID = I.IDEA_ID AND L.ANSR_ID = '' AND L.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE I.IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 아이디어 첨부파일 목록 idea.selectIdeaFileList */ SELECT IDEA_FILE_ID , IDEA_ID , FILE_PATH , FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE FROM TB_IDEA_FILE WHERE IDEA_ID = #{ideaId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT ASC, IDEA_FILE_ID ASC

/* 아이디어 첨부파일 단건 (삭제된 글의 파일은 제외) idea.selectIdeaFile */ SELECT F.IDEA_FILE_ID , F.IDEA_ID , F.FILE_PATH , F.FILE_NM , F.FILE_SIZE , F.FILE_TYPE FROM TB_IDEA_FILE F INNER JOIN TB_IDEA I ON I.IDEA_ID = F.IDEA_ID AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE F.IDEA_FILE_ID = #{ideaFileId}
/* 아이디어 공통코드 목록 (ID000001 진행상태 / ID000002 구분) idea.selectIdeaCodeList */ SELECT CODE_ID , CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID = #{codeGrpId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD ASC, CODE_ID ASC
